+#           county controller shares that faith, create one relic.
+#   Pass 2: for every faith with at least 3 county followers, at each of
+#           its eminent holy sites that still has no artifact, if the
+#           controller's faith rates the diaspora faith astray-or-better,
+#           create one relic anyway.
+#
+# Expected scopes on entry to any create_starting_relic_*_effect:

+# type: an empty tenets block on a rite falls back to the religion's core
+# tenets rather than the faith's, which would silently drop faith tenets.

@@ -0,0 +1,378 @@
+######################################
+# Heresy system - scripted triggers  #
+######################################
+# Per-heresy gating, geography helpers, and component eligibility checks.
+# Resurgence model: each historical heresy can fire more than once per game.
+#   first outbreak: pam_heresy_X_first_fired global var is unset
+#   resurgence:    first_fired set, plus pam_heresy_X_cooldown timed flag absent
+# A 50-year cooldown is set after every outbreak via timed global variable.
+
+# --- Component eligibility (faith scope) ---
+
+# The second and third heresy components are blocked below this
+# The first still fires, but we dampen the pulse with pam_heresy_pulse_no_event_value
+pam_heresy_main_rite_substantial_trigger = {
+	main_rite.rite_counties >= pam_heresy_main_rite_county_threshold_value
+}
+
+# Component 2 gate: main rite must be substantial (size floor) AND hold at least 60% of faith counties (dominance share).
+pam_heresy_c2_main_rite_dominant_trigger = {
+	pam_heresy_main_rite_substantial_trigger = yes
```

+	# Triggered list of icons, overriding which icon is used, set its filename here (without file ending).

+	# Default: Will look for icon in the path with the same name as key
+	#
+	# Supported scopes:

+	#
+	icon = {

+	}

+# 	script				- Created by the create_character effect
+#	ruler_designer		- Created by the ruler designer, any spouse or children generated for the custom character also have this reason
+# 	pool				- Created to populate the pool of wandering characters
+# 	guests				- Created to be a guest that randomly appears at a court
+# 	court_populator		- Created because a newly created court needed a courtier
+# 	mercenary_companies	- Created to be the commander of a mercenary band
+# The following five options are all automatically created new landed rulers:
+# 	succession			- Created as the new ruler of a title after succession if no existing character was a valid heir and the title shouldn't be destroyed
+# 	grant_titles		- Created when the AI wants to grant a county or barony away but no existing character is an appropriate recipient
+# 	great_holy_war		- Created to hold a barony after a victorious Great Holy War
+# 	migration			- A Herder created to hold titles left behind after nomadic migration
+# 	save_file_fix		- Created to be the holder of a County to fix a save game having a county without a holder that can sometimes be caused by baronies changing county

+	effect = {

```

@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+# Effects used by sanctify_artifact_interaction.
+# Root scope: the artifact being sanctified.
+# PRIEST = the clergyman performing the rite.
+#
+# Records the sanctification on the artifact itself: a faith-appropriate blessing epithet on its name,
+# and a line of description naming who sanctified it, for which faith. The owner also remembers the rite.
+sanctify_artifact_flavor_effect = {
+	save_scope_as = sanctified_artifact
+	$PRIEST$ = { save_scope_as = sanctifying_priest }
+
+	# Artifacts that already carry a holy, unique or epithet-bearing name keep it, and only gain the description line.
+	if = {
+		limit = {
+			is_holy_relic = no
+			has_none_of_variables = {
+				name = sanctified_artifact_var
+				name = blessed_artifact_var
+				name = cursed_artifact_var
+				name = historical_unique_artifact
+			}
```

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+########################
+# Rite Creation Names
+########################
+# When making a new dynamic (non-scripted) rite, its name will be picked from here if possible.
+# 
+# The logic works like this:
+# 1. Find an unused name from here if there is one whose trigger we meet
+# 2. Go through d_dynamic_rite_<number> until we find one that's unused
+# 3. Use the last d_dynamic_rite_<number> if we were unable to find anything
+# There can be up to 1000 d_dynamic_rite_<number> names (from 0 to 999 included) as long as there's no gaps.
+# 
+# Checking if a name is in used is purely based on the localized name; the other fields are derived from the name key.
+#
+# IMPORTANT NOTE
+# Rite, Founder and Faith scopes are available when localizing the dynamic names. Only use the provided Rite to check for e.g.
+#	Tenets and Doctrines, and DO NOT rely on Rite.GetName - you'll get either empty strings or the founder's old rite as a result.
+#
+key = {
+
+	# Optional. Defaults to <key>_name.

 #On actions related to religion
 
-# Code on-action: character creates a faith
+# Code on-action: a new faith is created (character create/convert, or a rite detaching into its own faith)
+# Root is the new faith; its head/leader is root.main_rite.head_of_rite (use it for faith-setup effects)
+# scope:founder is the acting character that triggered the creation (creator/converter, heresy declarer, or on a divergence the head of the diverging rite)
+# scope:founder can be absent - the game creates faiths with no acting character, so it is entered with ?=
+# scope:old_faith is the faith they used to have
+# scope:old_rite is the rite they used to have
+# scope:diverged (true/false) optional scope, true if the faith was created because of a Rite diverging too much. Notice create a 100+ divergence heresy at the start does not count.
+on_faith_created = {
+	effect = {
+		# Faiths created by a rite diverging too far start at 0 fervor
+		if = {
+			limit = {
+				scope:diverged ?= yes
+			}
+			diverged_faith_starting_fervor_effect = yes
+		}
+		# Sanctification is per faith
```

@@ -0,0 +1,870 @@
+namespace = heresy_historical
+
+####################################################################
+# Heresy outbreak system - Component 3: Historical heresy outbreak #
+####################################################################
+# Christianity-only. Each named heresy has a 50-year cooldown (timed global
+# variable) between successive outbreaks. The first outbreak of a named heresy
+# uses its historical founder; subsequent outbreaks ("resurgences") use a
+# secondary historical figure if available, otherwise a generic anonymous
+# preacher. Paulician / Iconoclast / Adoptionist / Messalian have no anchor
+# founder and are always anonymous repeating outbreaks.
+#
+# Resurgence weight is 30% of a first-fire weight, so historical outbreaks are
+# strictly more likely than their resurgences.
+#
+# Pre-declaration vs already-declared: the heresy faith may be in either state
+# at the time of any outbreak (first or resurgence). The pre-declaration setup
+# spawns a rite of the parent faith; the already-declared setup converts the
+# epicenter directly to the heresy faith.
+
```

+# Investiture Council: a slim variant of the Ecumenical Council convened at the end of the Investiture
+# Controversy to settle the Clerical Appointment doctrine. Not player-plannable (is_shown gated on the
+# nomination flag), started via an AI-host nudge. Summons + one Debate phase (no tenet debates); reuses the
+# ecumenical-council helpers with its own stance-based sort/tally, leaving the shipped one untouched. Host
+# champions Spiritual; the vote decides (innovators >= conservatives -> Spiritual, else Temporal), removing
+# Conditional either way.
+############################################################################################
+
+activity_investiture_council = {
+
+	notify_player_can_join_activity = yes
+
+	# Only visible to the AI host the situation nominates, so a player never sees it in the planner.
+	is_shown = {
+		has_pam_dlc_trigger = yes
+		has_character_flag = investiture_council_nominated
+	}
+
+	# The pending-council flag limits starting to the nominated host, not every eligible cleric

### 783. `game/common/customizable_localization/pam_saint_custom_loc.txt`

- **文件状态**: added
- **候选分类**: text_change
- **审查提示**: 已确认文本变化；目的、Bug 修复与玩法影响尚未验证
- **文件行数**: 0 → 599

旧版本不存在此文件。

**+599** 行新增，**-0** 行删除

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,599 @@
+
+# Canonizing Saints - custom localization
+# Swaps the Saint/canonize vocabulary per religion in one place: Christian faiths keep "Saint"/"canonize", religions with an attested term for the venerated dead use it (Wali, Divus, Siddha, Kami; gendered where the language genders it), and everything else falls back to "Venerated Ancestor"/"venerate" (matches the vanilla saint trait and 20_pam_flavorization.txt). Terms that denote a living holy person (Tzadik, Arhat, Sant, Zhenren, Sage, Ashavan) name the herald trait instead - see 00_traits.txt. These commands return single fragments only - the surrounding sentence stays a normal loc key so its saved scopes stay live, since a custom loc only carries the scope it is called on.
+# Gendered branches (Wali/Waliyya, Divus/Diva) resolve from the called scope, so call the noun commands on the saint (visited_saint, saint_candidate) when one is saved; scopeless/hypothetical contexts call on GetPlayer and read the generic masculine form as generic.
+
+# Verb: "canonize" (Christian) / "venerate" (other). Called on GetPlayer so it gates on the viewing player's religion, like the scopeless SelectLocalization keys.
+PamCanonizeVenerateVerb = {
+	type = character
+	text = {
+		trigger = {
+			faith.religion = religion:christianity_religion
+		}
+		localization_key = pam_canonize_verb_christian
+	}
+	text = {
+		trigger = {
+			faith.religion = religion:hellenism_religion
+		}
+		localization_key = pam_canonize_verb_hellenism
+	}
```

片段共省略 579 行（含上下文）；统计按完整差异计算。

+# Custom-loc helpers that resolve the ETenetApprovalStatus of a tenet

+			}
+		}
+		trigger = {

+# These commandline options are available when launching the game executable.

+##### NOTE: All of these are developer features! Use at your own risk. #####

+-skip
+

+
+# Select a specific bookmark to start at. Mainly important for start-year. (example: bm_867_carolingians)

+
+# Load and continue with the last savegame

### 852. `game/common/morpheme_strip_rules/00_morpheme_strip_rules.info`

- **文件状态**: added
- **候选分类**: text_change
- **审查提示**: 已确认文本变化；目的、Bug 修复与玩法影响尚未验证
- **文件行数**: 0 → 57

旧版本不存在此文件。

**+57** 行新增，**-0** 行删除

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+# Morpheme stripping rules for localization formatters.
+# Used via |:rule_name in loc strings (e.g. [Character.GetName|:english_rite_ism]ism).
+#
+# seek_from: "head" or "tail" (default "tail"). Controls the direction of matching
+# and stripping. "tail" matches/strips from the end; "head" from the start.
+#
+# Each entry defines ordered rules evaluated top-to-bottom (first match wins).
+# Within a rule, "match" blocks are character sets tested from the seek_from end
+# inward: first match = outermost char, second match = next char in, etc.
+# All match blocks must pass for the rule to fire. "strip" is how many characters
+# to remove from the seek_from end.
+#
+# If no rule matches, the input string is unchanged.
+#
+# Usage in localization:
+#   "$VALUE|:demo_tail$"    # applies tail rules
+#   "$VALUE|:demo_head$"    # applies head rules
+#   "$VALUE|U:demo_tail$"   # can be combined: uppercase-first, then strip
+#
+# Example inputs/outputs:
```

片段共省略 37 行（含上下文）；统计按完整差异计算。

+# menu (frontend) scene. The highest-priority entry whose dlc_feature is active
+# is chosen; a fallback entry (no dlc_feature, priority 0) is used otherwise.

+# Database folder: common/menu_scenes

+# 
+# The key is used together with the "main"/"heir"/"secondary" slots to look up
+# the bookmark portraits, so it must be unique per entry.
+example_scene = {

+	# Optional. DLC feature flag that must be active for this scene to be

-When making a new culture, its name will be picked from here if possible.
+########################
+# Culture Creation Names
+########################
+# When making a new culture, its name will be picked from here if possible.
+# 
+# The logic works like this:
+# 1. Find an unused name from here if there is one whose trigger we meet
+# 2. Go through HYBRID_NAME_FORMAT_<number> until we find one that's unused
+# 3. Use the last HYBRID_NAME_FORMAT_<number> if we were unable to find anything
+# For divergence, the format is DIVERGE_NAME_FORMAT_<number> instead.
+# There can be any number of name formats as long as there's no gaps.
+# 
+# Checking if a name is in used is purely based on the name field; collective noun and prefix we do not check the uniqueness of.

+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.desc_intro: "[host.GetFaith.HouseOfWorship|U] готовится растворить свои двери, и теперь ничто не мешает началу великого труда. Самое время заключать союзы"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.reformist: "между всеми — и королями, и священниками."
+ ecumenical_council_events.schism_crisis_intro: "\n\nНесмотря на тёплые приветствия, молчание между ними красноречивее любых слов. Рим и Константинополь больше не обмениваются любезностями, и любая незабытая обида создаёт ещё одну трещину в Теле Христа."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.first_tenet: "\n\nВоздух гудит от разговоров. Собравшиеся делают первые шаги: готовятся высказывать свои мнения относительно такого важного вопроса, как [ec_debate_topic_1.GetName( ROOT.GetCharacter.GetRite )|l], и многих других."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.host: "\n\nЯ широко раскрываю объятия и приглашаю своих детей совместно взяться за это грандиозное предприятие."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.guest: "\n\n«Добро пожаловать, дети мои. Да наставит нас Господь на пути к решению этой труднейшей задачи!» — с этими словами [host.GetTitledFirstName|l] подзывает нас."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.a: "Аминь."
```

@@ -0,0 +1,1001 @@
+l_french:
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001: "Le concile de [my_location.GetBaronyNameExplicitlyNoTooltip]"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.desc_intro: "Les magnifiques décorations sont partout autour des [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HouseOfWorshipPlural] pour l’occasion. Les plus éminents représentants de la chrétienté ont répondu"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.host: "à mon appel."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.dislikes_host: "au maudit appel [host.Custom('FR_du_Char_Pi')][host.GetTitledFirstName]."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.likes_host: "au légitime appel [host.Custom('FR_du_Char_Pi')][host.GetTitledFirstName]."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.neutral: "à l’appel [host.Custom('FR_du_Char_Pi')][host.GetTitledFirstName]."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.intent_arrived: "\n\nEt voilà que j’aperçois [intent_target.Custom('FR_le_Char_Pi')][intent_target.GetTitledFirstName] au milieu de l’assemblée. Parfait !"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.waiting_for_intent: "\n\nCe n’est qu’une question de temps avant que [intent_target.Custom('FR_le_Char_Pi')][intent_target.GetTitledFirstName] n’apparaisse..."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.no_intent_target: "\n\nJe n’ai plus qu’à attendre son arrivée !"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.a.bad: "Si nous n’avons pas d’autre choix."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.a.good: "Que notre devoir soit sanctifié."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.t: "L’appel"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.desc_intro: "Les portes [host.GetFaith.HouseOfWorship3] peuvent désormais s’ouvrir et nous pouvons enfin commencer notre œuvre. En prévision, il est temps de former des alliances"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.reformist: "entre rois et prêtres."
+ ecumenical_council_events.schism_crisis_intro: "\n\nL’accueil est chaleureux, mais le silence qui règne entre eux ne l’est pas. Rome et Constantinople n’échangent plus de politesses, et chaque différend non résolu constitue une nouvelle fracture au sein du Corps du Christ."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.first_tenet: "\n\nLes discussions vont bon train. Les personnes convoquées commencent à prendre position sur [ec_debate_topic_1.GetName( ROOT.GetCharacter.GetRite )|l] et d’autres affaires urgentes."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.host: "\n\nJ’ouvre les bras et j’accueille mes enfants, afin que nous fassions ensemble face à cet immense défi."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.guest: "\n\n« Bienvenue, mes enfants. Que le Seigneur nous guide dans cet immense défi qui est le nôtre ! », proclame [host.Custom('FR_le_Char_Pi')][host.GetTitledFirstName]."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.a: "Amen."
```

+l_japanese:

+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.desc_intro: "この日のため、[my_location.GetBaronyNameExplicitly]の[ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HouseOfWorshipPlural]は美しく飾り立てられている。キリスト教世界の錚々たる者たちが、"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.host: "私の呼びかけに応じて集うのだ。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.dislikes_host: "[host.Custom('InsultAdjective')][host.GetTitledFirstNamePossessive]の呼びかけに応じて集うのだ。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.likes_host: "[host.Custom('ComplimentAdjective')][host.GetTitledFirstNamePossessive]の呼びかけに応じて集うのだ。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.neutral: "[host.GetTitledFirstNamePossessive]の呼びかけに応じて集うのだ。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.intent_arrived: "\n\nそして早くも、集まった人々の中に[intent_target.GetTitledFirstName]の姿を見つけた。完璧だ！"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.waiting_for_intent: "\n\n[intent_target.GetTitledFirstName]が姿を現すのも時間の問題だ…"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.no_intent_target: "\n\nあとは彼らが到着するのを待つだけだ！"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.a.bad: "仕方ない、始めよう。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0001.a.good: "聖なる務めを果たすとしよう。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.t: "召集"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.desc_intro: "[host.GetFaith.HouseOfWorship]の扉が開いた。いよいよ我らの偉業が始まる。それに備えるため、"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.reformist: "王と聖職者の隔てなく、同盟を結ぶべき時である。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.schism_crisis_intro: "\n\n交わされる挨拶こそ穏やかだが、両陣営の間に流れる沈黙は冷ややかだ。ローマとコンスタンティノープルはもはや礼節を交わすこともない。癒やされぬままの争い一つ一つが、キリストの一なる御体に亀裂を生じさせている。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.first_tenet: "\n\nあたりは話し声で満ちている。召集された者たちが、[ec_debate_topic_1.GetName( ROOT.GetCharacter.GetRite )]やその他の差し迫った問題について、それぞれの立場を固め始めた。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.host: "\n\n私は両手を広げ、我が子らを迎え入れる。この重大な使命に、ともに立ち向かうために。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.guest: "\n\n「我が子らよ、ようこそ。主がこの重大な使命において我らを導かれますように！」[host.GetTitledFirstName]が我らを前へと手招きした。"
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.a: "アーメン。"
```

+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.host: "\n\n나는 두 팔을 벌려 신자들을 맞이했다. 함께 중대한 과제를 직면할 시간이었다."
+ ecumenical_council_events.0002.guest: "\n\n\"환영합니다, 신자 여러분. 부디 신께서 우리가 중대한 과제를 해결할 수 있도록 이끌어 주시기를!\" [host.GetTitledFirstName](이)가 손짓하며 우리를 앞으로 불렀다."

+ game_concept_puppet_types: "Типы марионеток"
+ game_concept_puppet_type_desc: "[Concept('puppet', 'Марионетка')|e] всегда принадлежит к одному из типов, которые определяют, какие действия она может предпринимать от вашего имени.\n\nХотя большинство действий доступны всем марионеткам, у каждого типа есть свои уникальные действия, доступные только ему.\n\nНапример, [Concept('clerical_puppet', 'державный священник — марионетка')|e] может [Concept('excommunicate', 'отлучить')|e] кого-то по вашему требованию, а [Concept('external_ruler_puppet', 'светского правителя — марионетку')|e] можно убедить освободить [Concept('tributary', 'данника')|e] или развестись с [Concept('spouse', 'супругой')|e].\n\nУ вас может быть не более одной марионетки каждого типа."
+ game_concept_puppet_desc: "Марионеткой называется [Concept('character', 'персонаж')|E], контролируемый [Concept('puppeteer', 'кукловодом')|E], который может совершать с его помощью особые манипулятивные действия.\n\nДействия с марионеткой открывают двери, которые в ином случае остались бы закрытыми: так, [Concept('clerical_puppet', 'державный священник — марионетка')|E] может от вашего имени просить о [Concept('clerical_titles', 'церковных титулах')|E] или [Concept('excommunication', 'отлучении')|E] неугодных, а [Concept('external_ruler_puppet', 'светского правителя — марионетку')|E] можно убедить освободить [Concept('tributary', 'данника')|E], предоставить независимость территории или развестись с [Concept('spouse', 'супругой')|E].\n\nВыбор доступных действий зависит от [Concept('puppet_type', 'типа марионетки')|E]."
+ game_concept_puppeteer: "Кукловод"
+ game_concept_puppeteers: "Кукловоды"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_possessive: "Кукловода"
+ game_concept_puppeteers_possessive: "Кукловодов"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_desc: "Кукловодом называется [Concept('character', 'персонаж')|E], контролирующий одну или несколько [Concept('puppets', 'марионеток')|E].\n\nЧерез своих марионеток кукловод может использовать рычаги влияния, недоступные ему самому: к примеру, управлять [Concept('clergy', 'духовенством')|E] или определять политику другой [Concept('realm', 'державы')|E]."
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet: "Державный священник-марионетка"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppets: "Державные священники — марионетки"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet_desc: "[Concept('realm_priest', 'Державный священник')|E] может быть [Concept('puppet', 'марионеткой')|E] своего [Concept('liege', 'сюзерена')|E].\n\nЧерез него кукловод может вмешиваться в дела соответствующей религиозной [Concept('faith', 'конфессии')|E]: просить её [Concept('head_of_faith', 'главу')|E] о [Concept('clerical_titles', 'церковных титулах')|E] или [Concept('excommunication', 'отлучении')|E] врагов, распоряжаться [Concept('holy_sites', 'святыми местами')|E], учреждать новые [Concept('rite', 'обряды')|E] и созывать [Concept('ecumenical_council', 'вселенские соборы')|E]."
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet: "Духовный правитель — марионетка"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppets: "Духовные правители — марионетки"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet_desc: "Так называется влиятельный представитель [Concept('clergy', 'духовенства')|E] — к примеру, [Concept('archbishop', 'архиепископ')|E] или даже [Concept('head_of_faith', 'глава конфессии')|E], — который стал [Concept('puppet', 'марионеткой')|E] другого [Concept('ruler', 'правителя')|E].\n\nЧем более высокую должность занимает ваша марионетка, тем больше возможностей она вам даёт: к примеру, глава конфессии может [Concept('excommunicate', 'отлучать')|E] ваших врагов от церкви, назначать [Concept('cardinals', 'кардиналов')|E], предоставлять [Concept('pressed_claim', 'обоснованные претензии')|E] и объявлять [Concept('holy_war', 'священные войны')|E] по вашему приказу."
```

片段共省略 272 行（含上下文）；统计按完整差异计算。

+ game_concept_puppet_type_desc: "[puppet|E] zawsze należy do konkretnego rodzaju, który wpływa na to, jakie działania może ona podejmować w twoim imieniu.\n\nChoć większość działań specjalnych jest wspólna dla wszystkich marionetek, to każdy ich rodzaj ma także własne, unikalne działania.\n\nNa przykład [clerical_puppet|El] może [excommunicate|El] kogoś w twoim imieniu, a [Concept('external_ruler_puppet', 'marionetkowego władcę świeckiego')|E] można zmusić do uwolnienia [Concept('tributary', 'trybutariusza')|E] lub wzięcia rozwodu z [Concept('spouse', 'małżonkiem')|E].\n\nMożesz mieć tylko po jednej marionetce danego rodzaju."
+ game_concept_puppet_desc: "Marionetka to [character|El] znajdująca się pod kontrolą [Concept('puppeteer', 'marionetkarza')|E], który może podejmować specjalne działania za jej pośrednictwem.\n\nDziałanie za pośrednictwem marionetki otwiera drzwi, które w przeciwnym razie pozostałyby zamknięte: [clerical_puppet|El] może ubiegać się o [clerical_titles|El] lub [Concept('excommunication', 'ekskomunikę')|E] w twoim imieniu, zaś [Concept('external_ruler_puppet', 'marionetkowego władcę świeckiego')|E] można zmusić do uwolnienia [Concept('tributaries', 'trybutariuszy')|E], przyznania niepodległości lub wzięcia rozwodu z [Concept('spouse', 'małżonkiem')|E].\n\nDostępne działania zależą od [Concept('puppet_type', 'rodzaju marionetki')|E]."
+ game_concept_puppeteer: "Marionetkarz"
+ game_concept_puppeteers: "Marionetkarze"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_possessive: "Marionetkarza"
+ game_concept_puppeteers_possessive: "Marionetkarzy"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_desc: "Marionetkarz to [character|El] sprawująca kontrolę nad jedną lub kilkoma [Concept('puppets', 'marionetkami')|E].\n\nDziałając za pośrednictwem swoich marionetek, marionetkarz zyskuje władzę niewynikającą z jego własnej pozycji – taką jak wpływy [Concept('clergy', 'duchowieństwa')|E] lub autorytet innego [Concept('realm', 'państwa')|E]."
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet: "Marionetkowy kapłan koronny"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppets: "Marionetkowi kapłani koronni"

+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet: "Marionetkowy władca duchowny"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppets: "Marionetkowi władcy duchowni"

+l_german:
+ game_concept_puppet: "Marionette"
+ game_concept_puppets: "Marionetten"
+ game_concept_puppeted: "zur Marionette gemacht"
+ game_concept_puppeting: "Marionette spielend"
+ game_concept_puppet_type: "Marionettenart"
+ game_concept_puppet_types: "Marionettenarten"
+ game_concept_puppet_type_desc: "Eine [puppet|e] hat immer eine Art, die darüber bestimmt, welche Aktionen in Eurem Namen durchgeführt werden dürfen.\n\nObwohl sie sich die meisten ihrer Spezialaktionen teilen, besitzt jede $game_concept_puppet_type$ einzigartige Aktionen, die nur für sie verfügbar sind.\n\nBeispielsweise kann eine [clerical_puppet|e] jemanden in Eurem Namen [excommunicate|el] oder eine [external_ruler_puppet|e] kann genötigt werden, einen [tributary|e] freizulassen oder sich vom eigenen [spouse|e] scheiden zu lassen.\n\nIhr dürft nur eine $game_concept_puppet$ von jeder Art haben."
+ game_concept_puppet_desc: "Eine Marionette ist ein [character|E] unter der Kontrolle eines [Concept('puppeteer', 'Puppenspielers')|E] steht, der besondere Marionettenaktionen über sie ausführen kann.\n\nÜber eine Marionette zu handeln, öffnet Türen, die ansonsten verschlossen bleiben würden: Eine [clerical_puppet|E] kann einen [clerical_titles|E] oder eine [excommunication|E] in Eurem Namen erbitten, während eine [external_ruler_puppet|E] genötigt werden kann, [tributaries|E] freizulassen, Unabhängigkeit zu gewähren oder sich vom eigenen [spouse|E] scheiden zu lassen.\n\nDie verfügbaren Aktionen werden durch die [puppet_type|E] bestimmt."
+ game_concept_puppeteer: "Puppenspieler"
+ game_concept_puppeteers: "Puppenspieler"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_possessive: "des Puppenspielers"
+ game_concept_puppeteers_possessive: "der Puppenspieler"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_desc: "Ein Puppenspieler ist ein [character|E], der die Kontrolle über eine oder mehr [puppets|E] hat.\n\nBeim Handeln über die eigenen Marionetten verfügt ein Puppenspieler über Macht, die ihm der eigene Stand nicht einräumen würde, beispielsweise Zugriff auf den [clergy|E] oder die Autorität eines anderen [Concept('realm', 'Reichs')|E]."
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet: "Reichspriester-Marionette"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppets: "Reichspriester-Marionetten"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet_desc: "Ein [realm_priest|E], der die [puppet|E] des eigenen [Concept('liege', 'Lehnsherrn')|E] ist.\n\nDurch ihn kann der Puppenspieler in Angelegenheiten des [Concept('faith', 'Glaubens')|E] eingreifen: das [head_of_faith|E] um [clerical_titles|E] oder eine [excommunication|E] bitten, [holy_sites|El] verwalten, einen neuen [rite|E] gründen oder ein [Concept('ecumenical_council', 'Ökumenisches Konzil')|E] ausrichten."
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet: "Klerusherrscher-Marionette"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppets: "Klerusherrscher Marionetten"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet_desc: "Ein einflussreiches Mitglied des [clergy|E] (ein [archbishop|E] oder gar [head_of_faith|E]), das zur [puppet|E] eines anderen [Concept('ruler', 'Herrschers')|E] geworden ist.\n\nJe mächtiger der Kleriker, desto größer sein Einfluss: Ein als Marionette benutztes Glaubensoberhaupt kann Eure Feinde [excommunicate|El], [cardinals|E] ernennen, einen [Concept('pressed_claim', 'durchgesetzten Anspruch')|E] gewähren oder einen [holy_war|E] für Euch anzetteln."

+ game_concept_puppeteers: "傀儡使い"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_possessive: "傀儡使い"
+ game_concept_puppeteers_possessive: "傀儡使い"

+ game_concept_clerical_puppet: "領国祭司の傀儡"

+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppets: "聖職統治者の傀儡"

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,277 @@
+l_russian:
+ # Canonizing Saints
+ # Christian faiths use Saint/Canonize wording; religions with an attested term for the venerated dead use it (Wali, Divus, Siddha, Kami - see pam_saint_custom_loc.txt); everything else uses Venerated Ancestor/Venerate (matches the vanilla saint trait and 20_pam_flavorization.txt). Three mechanisms: (1) scopeless keys pick the _saint/_va variant via SelectLocalization on the local player's religion, and the _va branch pulls its per-religion noun from a custom loc on GetPlayer; (2) scope-bearing keys whose only divergence is a single word/phrase swap just that fragment via a custom loc, keeping the sentence one key so its saved scopes stay live (called on the saint's scope where one exists, so gendered terms resolve); (3) clause-level scope-bearing keys (petition_sent, 0001.a.tt, 0002.desc, 0003.desc) keep the _saint/_va split and branch in script (triggered_desc), because their wording diverges across several phrases and they lean on multiple saved scopes a custom loc can't carry.
+ # Canonize decision
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U] персонажа [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVenerateObjectTitle')]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint: "Я позабочусь, чтобы одного из моих покойных родичей признали святым, канонизировали и прославили во свете небесном."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va: "Я позабочусь, чтобы один из моих покойных родичей был прославлен как [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')], [GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratedEnshrined')]ый должным образом"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint: "Причислить покойного члена вашей [Concept('dynasty', 'династия')|EU] к лику [Concept('sainthood', 'святых')|EU]."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va: "Позаботиться, чтобы покойный член вашей [Concept('dynasty', 'династия')|EU] прославился как [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')]."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_confirm: "Выберите место упокоения"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_candidate: "#EMP Покойный#! предок из ващей [Concept('dynasty', 'династии')|EU], не имеющий [Concept('sinful', 'греховных')|EU] свойств и имеющий как минимум одно [Concept('virtuous', 'добродетельное')|EU], но ещё не почитаемый"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site: "[Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile', 'Церковное поместье')|E] с [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building', 'собором')|E] для освящения в вашей [Concept('realm', 'державе')|EU], а если в ней нет свободных мест, то в соседней провинции"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site_holy_site: "[Concept('holy_site', 'Святое место')|E] вашей [Concept('faith', 'конфессии')|E] для освящения в вашей [Concept('realm', 'державе')|EU], а если в ней нет свободных мест, то в соседней провинции"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_canonize_tt: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U] выбранного покойного предка, [GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratingEnshrining')] его останки"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_tt: "Выберите [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building', 'собор')|E] в своей [Concept('realm', 'державе')|EU] для освящения мощей"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_holy_site_tt: "Выберите [Concept('holy_site', 'святое место')|E] вашей [Concept('faith', 'конфессии')|E] в своей [Concept('realm', 'державе')|EU] для освящения мощей"
+ # Clause-level split kept in script (triggered_desc): three phrases diverge and the sentence needs saint_candidate / consecration_province / petition_recipient, which a custom loc can't all carry.
+ pam_canonize_saint_petition_sent_tt_saint: "[petition_recipient.GetTitledFirstName] получит вашу просьбу признать, что [saint_candidate.GetFirstName] является [Concept('canonized',Select_CString(saint_candidate.IsFemale, 'святой', 'святым'))|E], [Select_CString(saint_candidate.IsFemale, 'чтимой', 'чтимым')] в провинции [consecration_province.GetName]"

+ game_concept_puppet_type_desc: "[puppet|e]에게는 언제나 유형이 있으며, 이 유형은 해당 꼭두각시가 당신 대신 수행하는 행동을 정합니다.\n\n각 $game_concept_puppet_type$은 대부분의 특수 행동을 공유하지만, 해당 유형만 사용 가능한 고유한 행동이 있습니다.\n\n예를 들어 [clerical_puppet|e]는 당신 대신 누군가를 [excommunicate|e]할 수 있으며, [external_ruler_puppet|e]의 경우 [tributary|e]을 해방하거나 [spouse|e]와 이혼하게 강요할 수 있습니다.\n\n유형당 한 명의 $game_concept_puppet$만 보유할 수 있습니다."

[clerical_puppet|E]는 당신을 대신해 [clerical_titles|E] 또는 [excommunication|E] 탄원을 할 수 있으며, [external_ruler_puppet|E]의 경우 [tributaries|E]을 해방하거나, 독립을 허용하거나, [spouse|E]와 이혼하게 할 수 있습니다.\n\n사용할 수 있는 행동은 [puppet_type|E]에 따라 달라집니다."

+l_french:

+ game_concept_puppet_types: "Types de fantoche"
+ game_concept_puppet_type_desc: "Chaque [puppet|el] appartient à un type qui détermine les actions qu’il peut effectuer à votre place.\n\nBien que la plupart de ses actions spéciales soient communes, chaque type dispose d’actions spécifiques.\n\nPar exemple, un [clerical_puppet|el] peut [excommunicate|el] quelqu’un à votre place, tandis qu’un [external_ruler_puppet|el] peut être contraint de libérer un [tributary|el] ou divorcer de son [spouse|el].\n\nVous ne pouvez posséder qu’un seul $game_concept_puppet|l$ de chaque type."
+ game_concept_puppet_desc: "[character|E] contrôlé par un [puppeteer|El], qui peut effectuer des actions spéciales par son intermédiaire.\n\nAgir par l’intermédiaire d’un fantoche ouvre des portes qui, autrement, resteraient fermées : un [clerical_puppet|El] peut demander des [clerical_titles|El] ou une [excommunication|El] en votre nom, tandis qu’un [external_ruler_puppet|El] peut être contraint de libérer des [tributaries|El], d’accorder l’indépendance ou de divorcer de son [spouse|El].\n\nLes actions disponibles dépendent du [puppet_type|El]."

+ game_concept_puppeteers: "Marionnettistes"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_possessive: "Marionnettiste"
+ game_concept_puppeteers_possessive: "Marionnettistes"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_desc: "[character|E] qui exerce un contrôle sur un ou plusieurs [puppets|El].\n\nEn agissant par l’intermédiaire de ses fantoches, le marionnettiste détient des pouvoirs que sa position ne lui confère pas, tels que l’influence du [clergy|El] ou l’autorité d’un autre [realm|El]."
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet: "Fantoche prêtre du pays"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppets: "Fantoches prêtres du pays"

+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet: "Fantoche dirigeant clérical"

+ study_faith_outcome.0010.desc.in_realm: "Не так давно я [Select_CString(ROOT.Char.IsFemale, 'попросила', 'попросил' )], чтобы к моему двору пришёл настоящий [target.GetAdherentName|l] из нашей державы. Стражники с любопытством разглядывают [Select_CString(study_faith_target.IsFemale, 'её', 'его' )]: они слышали о моих изысканиях."
+ study_faith_outcome.0010.a: "Поведай мне о [target.GetNameNoTooltip|l]ой вере."

+ study_faith_outcome.0101.a: "Пожалуй, моя душа готова к обращению."

+ study_faith_outcome.0103.a: "Непослушание чревато серьёзными последствиями…"
+ study_faith_outcome.0111.t: "Трудности с изучением [actor.GetRite.GetNameNoTooltip|l]ой веры"
+ study_faith_outcome.0111.desc: "Несмотря на все мои усилия, изучение #L [actor.GetRite.GetName|l]ой#! веры лишь привело меня в тупик! Мне совершенно непонятна воля [actor.GetFaith.HighGodNamePossessive], и я уже начинаю опасаться, что [Select_CString(actor.IsFemale, 'моя', 'мой' )] [ROOT.Char.Custom2('RelationToMeShort', SCOPE.sC('actor'))|l] [actor.GetFirstName] попросту заблуждается в своих убеждениях."

@@ -0,0 +1,292 @@
+l_spanish:
+ game_concept_puppet: "Títere"
+ game_concept_puppets: "Títeres"
+ game_concept_puppeted: "Manipulado"
+ game_concept_puppeting: "Manipular"
+ game_concept_puppet_type: "Tipo de títere"
+ game_concept_puppet_types: "Tipos de títeres"
+ game_concept_puppet_type_desc: "Todo [puppet|El] tiene siempre un tipo que determina las acciones que puede emprender por ti.\n\nSi bien la mayoría de sus acciones especiales son compartidas, cada $game_concept_puppet_type$ tiene acciones únicas solo disponibles para ese tipo.\n\nPor ejemplo, un [clerical_puppet|El] puede [excommunicate|El] a alguien por ti, mientras que a un [external_ruler_puppet|El] se le puede obligar a liberar a un [tributary|El] o a divorciarse de su [spouse|El].\n\nSolo puedes tener un $game_concept_puppet$ de cada tipo."
+ game_concept_puppet_desc: "Un títere es un [character|El] bajo el control de un [puppeteer|El], que puede llevar a cabo acciones especiales de títere a través de este.\n\nActuar mediante un títere abre puertas que de otro modo permanecerían cerradas: un [clerical_puppet|El] puede solicitar [clerical_titles|El] o una [excommunication|El] en tu nombre, mientras que a un [external_ruler_puppet|El] se le puede obligar a liberar [tributaries|El], conceder la independencia o divorciarse de su [spouse|El].\n\nLas acciones disponibles dependen del [puppet_type|El]."
+ game_concept_puppeteer: "Titiritero"
+ game_concept_puppeteers: "Titiriteros"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_possessive: "del titiritero"
+ game_concept_puppeteers_possessive: "de los titiriteros"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_desc: "Un titiritero es un [character|El] que ejerce control sobre uno o más [puppets|El].\n\nAl actuar a través de sus títeres, el titiritero ostenta poderes que su posición no le proporciona, como el alcance del [clergy|El] o la autoridad de otro [realm|El]."
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet: "Clérigo del señorío títere"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppets: "Clérigos del señorío títeres"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet_desc: "Un [realm_priest|El] que es un [puppet|El] de su [liege|El].\n\nA través de este, su titiritero puede inmiscuirse en los asuntos de la [faith|El]: hacer peticiones al [head_of_faith|El] para solicitar [clerical_titles|El] o una [excommunication|El], gestionar [holy_sites|El], fundar un [rite|El] nuevo o celebrar un [ecumenical_council|El]."
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet: "Gobernante clerical títere"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppets: "Gobernantes clericales títeres"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet_desc: "Un miembro poderoso del [clergy|El] —un [archbishop|El] o hasta el [head_of_faith|El]— que se ha convertido en el [puppet|El] de otro [ruler|El].\n\nCuanto más poderoso es el clérigo, mayor el alcance: un cabeza de la fe manipulado puede [excommunicate|El] a tus enemigos, nombrar [cardinals|El], conceder un [pressed_claim|El] o incitar a una [holy_war|El] por ti."
```

+l_english: 
+ game_concept_puppet: "Puppet"
+ game_concept_puppets: "Puppets"
+ game_concept_puppeted: "Puppeted"
+ game_concept_puppeting: "Puppeting"
+ game_concept_puppet_type: "Puppet Type"
+ game_concept_puppet_types: "Puppet Types"
+ game_concept_puppet_type_desc: "A [puppet|e] always has a type which determines the actions they may take on your behalf.\n\nWhile most of their special actions are shared, each $game_concept_puppet_type$ comes with unique actions only available to that type.\n\nFor instance, a [clerical_puppet|e] may [excommunicate|e] someone on your behalf, while a [external_ruler_puppet|e] may be compelled to release a [tributary|e] or divorce their [spouse|e].\n\nYou can only have one $game_concept_puppet$ per type."
+ game_concept_puppet_desc: "A Puppet is a [character|E] under the control of a [puppeteer|E], who may take special Puppet actions through them.\n\nActing through a Puppet opens doors that would otherwise stay closed: a [clerical_puppet|E] can petition for [clerical_titles|E] or an [excommunication|E] on your behalf, while a [external_ruler_puppet|E] can be made to release [tributaries|E], grant independence, or divorce their [spouse|E].\n\nThe actions available are determined by the [puppet_type|E]."
+ game_concept_puppeteer: "Puppeteer"
+ game_concept_puppeteers: "Puppeteers"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_possessive: "Puppeteer's"
+ game_concept_puppeteers_possessive: "Puppeteers'"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_desc: "A Puppeteer is a [character|E] in control of one or more [puppets|E].\n\nActing through their Puppets, a Puppeteer wields powers beyond their station, such as the influence of the [clergy|E] or the authority of a foreign [realm|E]."
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet: "Realm Priest Puppet"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppets: "Realm Priest Puppets"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet_desc: "A [realm_priest|E] that is a [puppet|E] of their [liege|E].\n\nThrough them, their Puppeteer can reach into the affairs of the [faith|E]: petitioning the [head_of_faith|E] for [clerical_titles|E] or an [excommunication|E], managing [holy_sites|E], founding a new [rite|E], or hosting an [ecumenical_council|E]."
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet: "Clerical Ruler Puppet"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppets: "Clerical Ruler Puppets"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet_desc: "A powerful member of the [clergy|E] — an [archbishop|E] or even the [head_of_faith|E] — that has become the [puppet|E] of another [ruler|E].\n\nThe mightier the cleric, the greater the reach: a puppeted Head of Faith can [excommunicate|E] your enemies, appoint [cardinals|E], grant a [pressed_claim|E], or incite a [holy_war|E] on your behalf."
```

+ study_scripture_outcome.10.desc_quote: "На самой верхней странице кто-то из прежних читателей подчеркнул один-единственный отрывок: #EMP «[ROOT.Char.Custom('RandomStudyVerseFragment')]»#!\n\nСколько же времени я [Select_CString(ROOT.Char.IsFemale, 'готова', 'готов')] посвятить священным писаниям?"
+ study_scripture_outcome.10.desc_generic: "Сколько же времени я [Select_CString(ROOT.Char.IsFemale, 'готова', 'готов')] посвятить священным писаниям?"

+ study_scripture_outcome.110.desc_quote: "Один отрывок обращается прямо к моей душе:\n#EMP «[ROOT.Char.Custom('RandomRelevantBibleQuote')]»#!\n\nЕсли я собираюсь стать пастырем последователей [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodNamePossessive], именно эти слова я [Select_CString(ROOT.Char.IsFemale, 'должна', 'должен')] хранить в своём сердце."

+ study_scripture_outcome.120.desc: "Прежде чем возглавить свою паству, я [Select_CString(ROOT.Char.IsFemale, 'должна', 'должен')] научиться управлять собой. Передо мной лежит толкование священных текстов, что [Select_CString(commentary_writer.IsFemale, 'составила', 'составил')] [commentary_writer.GetTitledFirstName] — густое, как заросли терновника, и столь же колючее. + game_concept_puppet_type_desc: "[puppet|e]始终拥有一个类型，该类型决定了他们可以代表你采取的行动。\n\n虽然他们的大部分特殊行动是共通的，但每种$game_concept_puppet_type$都有仅限该类型使用的独特行动。\n\n比如，一个[clerical_puppet|e]可以代表你将某人[excommunicate|e]，而一个[external_ruler_puppet|e]可以被迫释放[tributary|e]，或是和自己的[spouse|e]离婚。\n\n你每种类型最多只能拥有一个$game_concept_puppet$。"

+ game_concept_puppeteer: "操纵者"
+ game_concept_puppeteers: "操纵者"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_possessive: "操纵者"
+ game_concept_puppeteers_possessive: "操纵者"
+ game_concept_puppeteer_desc: "操纵者是控制着一个或多个[puppets|E]的[character|E]。\n\n通过傀儡行事，操纵者可行使自身所不具备的权力，例如[clergy|E]的影响力或另一[realm|E]的权威。"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet: "领地司祭傀儡"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppets: "领地祭司傀儡"
+ game_concept_clerical_puppet_desc: "作为自己[liege|E]的[puppet|E]的[realm_priest|E]。\n\n操纵者可以通过其插手[faith|E]事务：向[head_of_faith|E]请愿[clerical_titles|E]或[excommunication|E]、管理[holy_sites|E]、建立新的[rite|E]，或是举办[ecumenical_council|E]。"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppet: "神职统治者傀儡"
+ game_concept_external_clerical_puppets: "神职统治者傀儡"

**+277** 行新增，**-0** 行删除

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,277 @@
+l_french:
+ # Canonizing Saints
+ # Christian faiths use Saint/Canonize wording; religions with an attested term for the venerated dead use it (Wali, Divus, Siddha, Kami - see pam_saint_custom_loc.txt); everything else uses Venerated Ancestor/Venerate (matches the vanilla saint trait and 20_pam_flavorization.txt). Three mechanisms: (1) scopeless keys pick the _saint/_va variant via SelectLocalization on the local player's religion, and the _va branch pulls its per-religion noun from a custom loc on GetPlayer; (2) scope-bearing keys whose only divergence is a single word/phrase swap just that fragment via a custom loc, keeping the sentence one key so its saved scopes stay live (called on the saint's scope where one exists, so gendered terms resolve); (3) clause-level scope-bearing keys (petition_sent, 0001.a.tt, 0002.desc, 0003.desc) keep the _saint/_va split and branch in script (triggered_desc), because their wording diverges across several phrases and they lean on multiple saved scopes a custom loc can't carry.
+ # Canonize decision
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U] un [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVenerateObjectTitle')]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint: "Je ferai reconnaître l’un de mes défunts aïeux comme saint, afin qu’il soit consacré et repose dans la lumière."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va: "J’élèverai l’un de mes défunts aïeux au rang de [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')], et sa dépouille sera [GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratedEnshrined')]e avec tous les honneurs qui lui sont dus."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint: "Élevez un membre décédé de votre [dynasty|El] à la [sainthood|El]."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va: "Élevez un membre décédé de votre [dynasty|El] au rang de [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')]."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_confirm: "Choisissez un lieu de sépulture"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_candidate: "Un ancêtre décédé de votre [dynasty|El], dépourvu de trait [sinful|El] et possédant au moins un trait [virtuous|El], qui n’est pas encore vénéré"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site: "Une [ecclesiastical_domicile|El] avec une [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','cathédrale')|E] dans votre [realm|El] où le consacrer ou, si toutes sont occupées, une province voisine"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site_holy_site: "Un [holy_site|El] de votre [faith|El] dans votre [realm|El] où le consacrer ou, si tous sont occupés, une province voisine"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_canonize_tt: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U] le défunt membre de la dynastie choisi et [GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecrateEnshrine')] sa dépouille"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_tt: "Choisissez la [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','cathédrale')|E] dans votre [realm|E] dans laquelle le consacrer"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_holy_site_tt: "Choisissez le [holy_site|El] de votre [faith|El] dans votre [realm|El] dans lequel le consacrer"
+ # Clause-level split kept in script (triggered_desc): three phrases diverge and the sentence needs saint_candidate / consecration_province / petition_recipient, which a custom loc can't all carry.
+ pam_canonize_saint_petition_sent_tt_saint: "Une requête sera adressée [petition_recipient.Custom('FR_au_Char_Pi')][petition_recipient.GetTitledFirstName] afin qu’[saint_candidate.Custom('FR_IlElle')] approuve la reconnaissance de la [Concept('canonized','sainteté')|E] de [saint_candidate.GetFirstName] et sa consécration en [consecration_province.GetName]"
```

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,277 @@
+l_spanish:
+ # Canonizing Saints
+ # Christian faiths use Saint/Canonize wording; religions with an attested term for the venerated dead use it (Wali, Divus, Siddha, Kami - see pam_saint_custom_loc.txt); everything else uses Venerated Ancestor/Venerate (matches the vanilla saint trait and 20_pam_flavorization.txt). Three mechanisms: (1) scopeless keys pick the _saint/_va variant via SelectLocalization on the local player's religion, and the _va branch pulls its per-religion noun from a custom loc on GetPlayer; (2) scope-bearing keys whose only divergence is a single word/phrase swap just that fragment via a custom loc, keeping the sentence one key so its saved scopes stay live (called on the saint's scope where one exists, so gendered terms resolve); (3) clause-level scope-bearing keys (petition_sent, 0001.a.tt, 0002.desc, 0003.desc) keep the _saint/_va split and branch in script (triggered_desc), because their wording diverges across several phrases and they lean on multiple saved scopes a custom loc can't carry.
+ # Canonize decision
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U] [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVenerateObjectTitle')|l]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint: "Propondré que se reconozca a uno de mis parientes fallecidos como santo, de este modo será consagrado y descansará bajo la luz."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va: "Elevaré a uno de mis parientes fallecidos para que sea honrado como [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')], y sus restos descansarán en un santuario para ser [GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratedEnshrined')]s como merecen."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint: "Eleva a un miembro fallecido de tu [dynasty|El] a la [sainthood|El]."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va: "Eleva a un miembro fallecido de tu [dynasty|El] a [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')]."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_confirm: "Elegir un lugar de descanso"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_candidate: "Un ancestro #EMP fallecido#! de tu [dynasty|El] sin un rasgo [sinful|El] y al menos un rasgo [virtuous|El], a quien aún no se venere"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site: "Una [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile','finca eclesiástica')|E] con una [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','catedral')|E] en tu [realm|El] en la que consagrarlo o, cuando todas estén ocupadas, una provincia vecina"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site_holy_site: "Un [Concept('holy_site','lugar sagrado')|E] de tu [faith|El] en tu [realm|El] en el que consagrarlo o, cuando todos estén ocupados, una provincia vecina"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_canonize_tt: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U] al cabeza de la dinastía elegido que ya no está entre nosotros, [GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratingEnshrining')] sus restos"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_tt: "Elige la [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','catedral')|E] en tu [realm|El] en la que consagrarlo"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_holy_site_tt: "Elige el [Concept('holy_site','lugar sagrado')|E] de tu [faith|El] en tu [realm|El] en el que consagrarlo"
+ # Clause-level split kept in script (triggered_desc): three phrases diverge and the sentence needs saint_candidate / consecration_province / petition_recipient, which a custom loc can't all carry.
+ pam_canonize_saint_petition_sent_tt_saint: "Se enviará una petición [petition_recipient.Custom('ES_AlAla')] [petition_recipient.GetTitledFirstName|l] para que apruebe el reconocimiento de [saint_candidate.GetFirstName] como [Concept('canonized','sant')|E][saint_candidate.Custom('ES_OA')] y su consagración en [consecration_province.GetName]"
```

**+277** 行新增，**-0** 行删除

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,277 @@
+l_german:
+ # Canonizing Saints
+ # Christian faiths use Saint/Canonize wording; religions with an attested term for the venerated dead use it (Wali, Divus, Siddha, Kami - see pam_saint_custom_loc.txt); everything else uses Venerated Ancestor/Venerate (matches the vanilla saint trait and 20_pam_flavorization.txt). Three mechanisms: (1) scopeless keys pick the _saint/_va variant via SelectLocalization on the local player's religion, and the _va branch pulls its per-religion noun from a custom loc on GetPlayer; (2) scope-bearing keys whose only divergence is a single word/phrase swap just that fragment via a custom loc, keeping the sentence one key so its saved scopes stay live (called on the saint's scope where one exists, so gendered terms resolve); (3) clause-level scope-bearing keys (petition_sent, 0001.a.tt, 0002.desc, 0003.desc) keep the _saint/_va split and branch in script (triggered_desc), because their wording diverges across several phrases and they lean on multiple saved scopes a custom loc can't carry.
+ # Canonize decision
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamVenerateObjectTitle')|U] [GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|l]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc: "[SelectLocalization(ObjectsEqual(GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey('christianity_religion').GetName), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va')]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint: "Ich werde einen dahingeschiedenen Verwandten von mir vorschlagen, der als Heiliger geweiht und im Licht zur letzten Ruhe gebettet werden soll."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va: "Ich werde einen dahingeschiedenen Verwandten von mir vorschlagen, der als [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')] zu ehren ist und dessen sterbliche Überreste mit allem gebührenden Respekt [GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratedEnshrined')|l] werden sollen."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip: "[SelectLocalization(ObjectsEqual(GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey('christianity_religion').GetName), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va')]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint: "Erhebt ein dahingeschiedenes Mitglied Eurer [dynasty|E] durch eine [sainthood|E]."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va: "Erhebt ein dahingeschiedenes Mitglied Eurer [dynasty|EU] in den Stand als [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')]."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_confirm: "Eine Ruhestätte auswählen"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_candidate: "Ein #EMP dahingeschiedener#! Ahn aus Eurer [dynasty|EU] ohne eine [Concept('sinful', 'sündhafte')|E] Eigenschaft und mit mindestens einer [Concept('virtuous', 'tugendhaften')|E] Eigenschaft, der noch nicht geehrt wurde"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site: "Ein [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile','Kirchenanwesen')|E] mit einer [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','Kathedrale')|E] in Eurem [realm|E], in dem eine Weihe stattfinden kann – oder in einer benachbarten Provinz, sobald alle besetzt sind"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site_holy_site: "Eine [Concept('holy_site','heilige Stätte')|E] Eures [Concept('faith', 'Glaubens')|E] in Eurem [realm|E], an der eine Weihe stattfinden kann – oder in einer benachbarten Provinz, sobald alle besetzt sind"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_canonize_tt: "Das ausgewählte dahingeschiedene Dynastieoberhaupt [GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|l], indem seine sterblichen Überreste [GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratedEnshrined')|l] werden"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_tt: "Die [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','Kathedrale')|E] in Eurem [realm|E] auswählen, wo die Weihe stattfinden soll"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_holy_site_tt: "Die [Concept('holy_site','heilige Stätte')|E] Eures [Concept('faith', 'Glaubens')|E] in Eurem [realm|EU], wo die Weihe stattfinden soll"
+ # Clause-level split kept in script (triggered_desc): three phrases diverge and the sentence needs saint_candidate / consecration_province / petition_recipient, which a custom loc can't all carry.
+ pam_canonize_saint_petition_sent_tt_saint: "Eine Petition, [saint_candidate.GetFirstName] als [Concept('canonized','Heiligen')|E], der in [consecration_province.GetName] geweiht werden soll, wird zwecks einer Genehmigung an [petition_recipient.GetTitledFirstName] geschickt"
```

+ study_faith_outcome.0101.t: "[actor.GetFaith.HighGodName](와)과 잘 아는 사이"
+ study_faith_outcome.0101.desc: "[actor.GetRite.GetName](을)를 힘들게 공부한 결과, 내 [ROOT.Char.Custom2('RelationToMeShort', SCOPE.sC('actor'))] [actor.GetName](을)를 더 잘 이해하게 되었다. 하지만 무엇보다도 [actor.GetFaith.GoodGodNames]의 길을 걷는 방법을 알게 되었다."
+ study_faith_outcome.0101.a: "이제 개종할 때가 왔군."
+ study_faith_outcome.0101.b: "[ROOT.Char.GetFaith.GoodGodNames](을)를 버릴 수는 없다!"

+ study_faith_outcome.0103.a: "불복에는 대가가 따르는 법..."

@@ -0,0 +1,137 @@
+l_russian:
+ ##################################################
+ # CHRISTIAN SITUATION EVENTS
+ ##################################################
+ #Fragile Unity Phase
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.t: "$situation_the_christian_church$ — [GetSituation('the_christian_church').GetTopCurrentPhase.GetType.GetNameNoTooltip]"
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.desc.intro: "[GetSituation('the_christian_church').GetTopSubRegion.GetName] объединяет в себе множество земель, населённых народами самых разных языков и культур, которые далеко не всегда уживаются друг с другом.\n\nОднако сегодня нам как никогда нужна сплочённость. Конец времён уже близок. Три всадника — чума, война и ересь — уже стоят у нашего порога, готовые испытать наше единство.\n\nКак [st_paul.GetName] когда-то [Select_CString(st_paul.IsFemale, 'обращалась', 'обращался' )] к коринфянам с призывом сплотиться, так и мы призываем всех [Concept('christians', 'христиан')|E] проявить единодушие: [Glossary( 'non sint in vobis schismata', '1_CORINTHIANS_1_10_LATIN_GLOSS' )]. В противном случае нас всех с головой поглотит ересь, и тогда каждый из нас станет марионеткой в руках Антихриста.\n\n"
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.desc.unreformed_pagan: "Наши мягкотелые соседи-[Concept('christians', 'христиане')|E] поклоняются жалкому и завистливому богу. Подобно детям, они спорят о природе своего кумира. Они растеряли бдительность, их мечи давно не вкушали крови врагов и затупились в ножнах.\n\nИ эту слабость они стремятся навязать нам, послав в наши земли своих святош. Пожалуй, мы сами заглянем к ним в гости и хорошенько пограбим местные богатства! Тогда, возможно, они вспомнят, каково это — быть действительно сильными."
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.desc.heathen_rulers: "Наши соседи-[Concept('christian', 'христиане')|E] — сборище неотёсанных, постоянно бранящихся между собой народов. Душа у этих последователей [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodNamePossessive] столь же чиста, сколь и вода в пруду, заросшем илом. Они навсегда застряли в прошлом и не видят, что своими верованиями сами копают себе могилу.\n\nМы заберём их сокровища — сколь бы мало там ни было. Мы покорим их мужчин и женщин — сколь бы ленивыми они ни были."
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.desc.heretic_rulers: "[st_peter.GetName] [Select_CString(st_peter.IsFemale, 'возрыдала', 'возрыдал' )] бы, увидев, какой осёл сегодня занимает названную в [Select_CString(st_peter.IsFemale, 'её', 'его' )] честь кафедру. Этот человек смеет называть нас еретиками только за то, что мы сохранили истинную веру! Если бы Христос вновь спустился на землю, он наверняка бы принял фарисейство и призвал вновь распять нашего Господа.\n\nВзгляните, какой раздор царит среди тех, кто называет Христа Господом! Лжепророк в Риме посеял зерно раздора в хорошо удобренную почву.\n\nНаместник Сатаны на земле стремится сделать нас мучениками. Эту язву давно пора прижечь во имя спасения всех [Concept('christians', 'христиан')|E]!"
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.desc.western: "Влияние епископа Рима уже не то, что прежде. Ответственность за устранение разделившего нашу веру раскола в преддверии Страшного суда ложится на нас."
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.desc.eastern: "Нас окружают враги Христа, и Страшный суд близок. Нужно поскорее найти общий язык с епископом Рима."
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.desc.investiture_temporal: "\n\nСовет разрешил правителям свободно отстранять прелатов, назначенных церковью."
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.desc.oriental_orthodox: "«[Glossary( 'Mia physis tou theou logou sesarkomene', 'MIAPHYSITISM_GLOSS' )]». Страшный суд близок. Нужно наставить наших братьев на путь к свету."
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.a: "Да направит нас Христос!"
+ pam_the_christian_church.0051.b: "Будем внимательно следить за последователями Христа."
+ MIAPHYSITISM_GLOSS: "#bold «Поистине есть одна природа Бога Слова воплощённая!»#! — так провозгласил святой Кирилл Александрийский на Эфесском соборе в 431 году. Эта христологическая доктрина, называемая миафизитством, получила распространение в восточных православных церквях."
+ #Saeculum Obscurum Phase
+ pam_the_christian_church.0052.t: "$situation_the_christian_church$ — [GetSituation('the_christian_church').GetTopCurrentPhase.GetType.GetNameNoTooltip]"
+ pam_the_christian_church.0052.desc.intro: "Из непроглядной тьмы, в которой пребывает [GetSituation('the_christian_church').GetTopSubRegion.GetName], звучит многоголосый хор:\n\n#EMP «Рим хочет быть новым Содомом!»#!\n\n#EMP «Папа — и сводник, и блудница!»#!\n\nДаже те, кто придерживается умеренных взглядов, не могут не признать: церковь давно нуждается в реформах."

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,277 @@
+l_japanese:
+ # Canonizing Saints
+ # Christian faiths use Saint/Canonize wording; religions with an attested term for the venerated dead use it (Wali, Divus, Siddha, Kami - see pam_saint_custom_loc.txt); everything else uses Venerated Ancestor/Venerate (matches the vanilla saint trait and 20_pam_flavorization.txt). Three mechanisms: (1) scopeless keys pick the _saint/_va variant via SelectLocalization on the local player's religion, and the _va branch pulls its per-religion noun from a custom loc on GetPlayer; (2) scope-bearing keys whose only divergence is a single word/phrase swap just that fragment via a custom loc, keeping the sentence one key so its saved scopes stay live (called on the saint's scope where one exists, so gendered terms resolve); (3) clause-level scope-bearing keys (petition_sent, 0001.a.tt, 0002.desc, 0003.desc) keep the _saint/_va split and branch in script (triggered_desc), because their wording diverges across several phrases and they lean on multiple saved scopes a custom loc can't carry.
+ # Canonize decision
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamVenerateObjectTitle')]を[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U]する"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint: "亡き親族の一人を神聖なる聖人として列聖させ、光の中に安置されるよう取り計らおう。"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va: "亡き親族の一人を[GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')]として讃え、その遺骸をしかるべき敬意をもって[GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratedEnshrined')]する。"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint: "亡き[dynasty|EU]の成員を[sainthood|EU]に昇格させる。"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va: "亡き[dynasty|EU]の一員を[GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')]に列する。"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_confirm: "安息の地を選ぶ"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_candidate: "[sinful|EU]の特性がなく、少なくとも1つの[virtuous|EU]の特性を持つあなたの[dynasty|EU]の#EMP 亡き#!先祖のうち、まだ尊敬されていない人物"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site: "あなたの[realm|EU]内の[Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile','教会所領')|E]のうち、対象を祀るための[Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','聖堂')|E]を持つもの。すべてが使用中の場合は、隣接する属州"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site_holy_site: "あなたの[realm|EU]内の、あなたの[faith|EU]の[Concept('holy_site','聖地')|E]のうち、対象を祀るために使用できるもの。すべてが使用中の場合は、隣接する属州"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_canonize_tt: "選ばれた亡き王朝の一員を[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U]し、その遺骸を[GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratingEnshrining')]する"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_tt: "あなたの領国内の、対象を祀るための[Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','聖堂')|E]を選択する"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_holy_site_tt: "あなたの領国内のあなたの[faith|EU]の[Concept('holy_site','聖地')|E]の中から、対象を祀るための場所を選択する"
+ # Clause-level split kept in script (triggered_desc): three phrases diverge and the sentence needs saint_candidate / consecration_province / petition_recipient, which a custom loc can't all carry.
+ pam_canonize_saint_petition_sent_tt_saint: "[saint_candidate.GetFirstName]を聖なる[Concept('canonized','聖人')|E]と認め、[consecration_province.GetName]に祀るための請願書が、承認を得るために[petition_recipient.GetTitledFirstName]へと送られる"
```

**+293** 行新增，**-0** 行删除

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,293 @@
+l_english:
+ # Canonizing Saints
+ # Christian faiths use Saint/Canonize wording; religions with an attested term for the venerated dead use it (Wali, Divus, Siddha, Kami - see pam_saint_custom_loc.txt); everything else uses Venerated Ancestor/Venerate (matches the vanilla saint trait and 20_pam_flavorization.txt). Three mechanisms: (1) scopeless keys pick the _saint/_va variant via SelectLocalization on the local player's religion, and the _va branch pulls its per-religion noun from a custom loc on GetPlayer; (2) scope-bearing keys whose only divergence is a single word/phrase swap just that fragment via a custom loc, keeping the sentence one key so its saved scopes stay live (called on the saint's scope where one exists, so gendered terms resolve); (3) clause-level scope-bearing keys (petition_sent, 0001.a.tt, 0002.desc, 0003.desc) keep the _saint/_va split and branch in script (triggered_desc), because their wording diverges across several phrases and they lean on multiple saved scopes a custom loc can't carry.
+
+ # Canonize decision
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U] [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVenerateObjectTitle')]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint: "I shall put forward one of my departed kin to be recognized as a holy saint, consecrated and laid to rest in light."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va: "I shall raise one of my departed kin to be honoured as [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')], their remains [GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratedEnshrined')] with all due reverence."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint: "Elevate a departed member of your [dynasty|EU] to [sainthood|EU]."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va: "Elevate a departed member of your [dynasty|EU] to [GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')]."
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_confirm: "Choose a Resting Place"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_candidate: "A #EMP departed#! ancestor of your [dynasty|EU], free of [sinful|EU] traits, bearing a [virtuous|EU] trait, and as of yet unvenerated"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site: "An [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile','Ecclesiastical Estate')|E] with a [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','Cathedral')|E] in your [realm|EU] in which to consecrate them - or, once every one is occupied, a neighbouring province"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site_holy_site: "A [Concept('holy_site','Holy Site')|E] of your [faith|EU] within your [realm|EU] at which to consecrate them - or, once every one is occupied, a neighbouring province"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_canonize_tt: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U] the chosen departed dynast, [GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratingEnshrining')] their remains"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_tt: "Choose the [Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','Cathedral')|E] within your [realm|EU] in which to consecrate them"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_holy_site_tt: "Choose the [Concept('holy_site','Holy Site')|E] of your [faith|EU] within your [realm|EU] at which to consecrate them"
+ # Clause-level split kept in script (triggered_desc): three phrases diverge and the sentence needs saint_candidate / consecration_province / petition_recipient, which a custom loc can't all carry.
```

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,277 @@
+l_simp_chinese:
+ # Canonizing Saints
+ # Christian faiths use Saint/Canonize wording; religions with an attested term for the venerated dead use it (Wali, Divus, Siddha, Kami - see pam_saint_custom_loc.txt); everything else uses Venerated Ancestor/Venerate (matches the vanilla saint trait and 20_pam_flavorization.txt). Three mechanisms: (1) scopeless keys pick the _saint/_va variant via SelectLocalization on the local player's religion, and the _va branch pulls its per-religion noun from a custom loc on GetPlayer; (2) scope-bearing keys whose only divergence is a single word/phrase swap just that fragment via a custom loc, keeping the sentence one key so its saved scopes stay live (called on the saint's scope where one exists, so gendered terms resolve); (3) clause-level scope-bearing keys (petition_sent, 0001.a.tt, 0002.desc, 0003.desc) keep the _saint/_va split and branch in script (triggered_desc), because their wording diverges across several phrases and they lean on multiple saved scopes a custom loc can't carry.
+ # Canonize decision
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U][GetPlayer.Custom('PamVenerateObjectTitle')]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_saint: "我将推举我的一位已故亲属成为受认可的圣人，接受祝圣并在光明中安息。"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_desc_va: "我将推举我的一位已故亲属成为[GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')]，其遗体以合适的敬礼接受[GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratedEnshrined')]。"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip: "[SelectLocalization( ObjectsEqual( GetPlayer.GetFaith.GetReligion.GetName, GetReligionByKey( 'christianity_religion' ).GetName ), 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint', 'pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va' )]"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_saint: "将你的一名去世的[dynasty|EU]成员奉为[sainthood|EU]。"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_tooltip_va: "将你的一名去世的[dynasty|EU]成员晋升为[GetPlayer.Custom('PamVeneratedSaintOrAncestorGeneric')]。"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_confirm: "选择安息之地"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_candidate: "你的[dynasty|EU]的一名没有[sinful|EU]特质且拥有至少一个[virtuous|EU]特质的#EMP 已过世#!祖先尚未被尊崇"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site: "在你的[realm|EU]内存在拥有[Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','主教座堂')|E]的[Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile','教会庄园')|E]可用于为其祝圣；或者，若所有该类建筑已被占据，亦可使用相邻省份"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_req_site_holy_site: "在你的[realm|EU]内存在拥有你的[faith|EU][Concept('holy_site','圣地')|E]可用于为其祝圣；或者，若所有圣地已被占据，亦可使用相邻省份"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_canonize_tt: "[GetPlayer.Custom('PamCanonizeVenerateVerb')|U]选择的过世宗族成员，[GetPlayer.Custom('PamConsecratingEnshrining')]其遗骸"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_tt: "选择你[realm|EU]内的[Concept('ecclesiastical_domicile_building','主教座堂')|E]用于祝圣"
+ pam_canonize_saint_decision_choose_1_holy_site_tt: "选择你[realm|EU]内的[faith|EU][Concept('holy_site','圣地')|E]用于祝圣"
+ # Clause-level split kept in script (triggered_desc): three phrases diverge and the sentence needs saint_candidate / consecration_province / petition_recipient, which a custom loc can't all carry.
+ pam_canonize_saint_petition_sent_tt_saint: "一封请求在[consecration_province.GetName]祝圣[saint_candidate.GetFirstName]使其成为[Concept('canonized','圣人')|E]的请愿书将被送交[petition_recipient.GetTitledFirstName]等待批准"
```

Eine Kerze glimmt in der Dunkelheit. Unten im Gotteshaus ([ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HouseOfWorship]) warten die Gläubigen so, wie sie es immer tun.\n\n"
+ study_scripture_outcome.10.desc_quote: "Auf der obersten Seite unterstrich ein Leser vor mir einen einzelnen Abschnitt: #EMP „[ROOT.Char.Custom('RandomStudyVerseFragment')]“#!\n\nWie viel von mir selbst soll ich diesen heiligen Seiten geben?"
+ study_scripture_outcome.10.desc_generic: "Wie viel von mir selbst werde ich der heiligen Bildung geben?"
+ study_scripture_outcome.10.a: "Lasst die Wunder der Welt hinter der Klostertür warten."
+ study_scripture_outcome.10.b: "Das Studium sollte seine festen Zeiten haben, so wie [ROOT.Char.Custom('StudyOfficesWord')] die ihren."
+ study_scripture_outcome.10.c: "Ich werde lesen, wann immer mich der Geist bewegt."
+ no_change_study_scripture_tt: "Euer [GetScheme('study_scripture').GetTypeName]s-[scheme|E] schreitet unverändert voran"
+ study_scripture_outcome.110.t: "$study_scripture_title$Die heilige Seite"
+ study_scripture_outcome.110.desc: "Ich arbeite mich Zeile um Zeile durch die großen Texte des Glaubens ([ROOT.Char.GetFaith.GetName]), während sich Wachs um den Kerzenstummel herum sammelt und die Kaninchen und Schnecken in den Randbemerkungen miteinander streiten.\n\n"
+ study_scripture_outcome.110.desc_quote: "Eine Textstelle spricht mich an:\n#EMP „[ROOT.Char.Custom('RandomRelevantBibleQuote')]“#!\n\nWenn ich die Gläubigen der höchsten Macht ([ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodName]) hüten soll, muss ich diese Worte in meinem Herzen tragen."
+ study_scripture_outcome.110.desc_generic: "Wenn ich die Gläubigen der höchsten Macht ([ROOT.Char.GetFaith.HighGodName]) hüten soll, sind dies die Worte, die ich in meinem Herzen tragen muss."
+ study_scripture_outcome.110.a: "Ich muss lernen, was auch immer ich dafür geben muss."
+ study_scripture_outcome.110.b: "Das Verständnis wird zu seiner Zeit kommen."
+ study_scripture_outcome.120.t: "$study_scripture_title$Der lange Kommentar"
+ study_scripture_outcome.120.desc: "Bevor ich meine Herde führen kann, muss ich lernen, mich selbst zu führen. Der Kommentar von [commentary_writer.GetTitledFirstName] liegt geöffnet vor mir – die lebenslange Arbeit eines anderen Gelehrten am Text ([ROOT.Char.GetFaith.ReligiousText]), so undurchdringlich wie ein Dornengestrüpp und doppelt so scharf. Jede Zeile, die ich kläre, gibt drei weitere preis.\n\nNur durch Disziplin werde ich obsiegen."
+ study_scripture_outcome.120.a: "Ich werde den Text nach einer tieferen Bedeutung durchgehen."
+ study_scripture_outcome.120.b: "Stete Stunden, steter Fortschritt."
+ study_scripture_outcome.120.c: "Eine Seite pro Nacht genügt."
```

+ pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_masterwork: "Запечатанный сосуд с освящённым миром: [Glossary('меккский бальзам','pam_myron_gloss_balsam')], [Glossary('ладан','pam_myron_gloss_frankincense')] и [Glossary('смирна','pam_myron_gloss_myrrh')], пропитанные чистым оливковым маслом. + pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_famed: "Запечатанный сосуд с освящённым миром: [Glossary('меккский бальзам','pam_myron_gloss_balsam')], [Glossary('ладан','pam_myron_gloss_frankincense')], [Glossary('смирна','pam_myron_gloss_myrrh')], [Glossary('нард','pam_myron_gloss_spikenard')] и [Glossary('корица','pam_myron_gloss_cinnamon')], пропитанные чистым оливковым маслом. В миро добавлена капелька из предыдущей партии — так цепочка благословлений не прекращается со времён апостолов."
+ pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_illustrious: "Запечатанный сосуд с освящённым миром, изготовленным в полном соответствии с древнейшими рецептами: [Glossary('меккский бальзам','pam_myron_gloss_balsam')], [Glossary('ладан','pam_myron_gloss_frankincense')], [Glossary('смирна','pam_myron_gloss_myrrh')], [Glossary('нард','pam_myron_gloss_spikenard')], [Glossary('корица','pam_myron_gloss_cinnamon')], [Glossary('аир','pam_myron_gloss_calamus')] и [Glossary('кассия','pam_myron_gloss_cassia')], пропитанные чистым оливковым маслом. В миро добавлена капелька из предыдущей партии — так цепочка благословлений не прекращается со времён апостолов."
+ pam_holy_myron_charges_line: "Осталось помазаний: #V [pam_myron_vessel.MakeScope.Var('pam_holy_myron_charges').GetValue|V0]#!"
+ pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_charged_common: "$pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_common$\n\n$pam_holy_myron_charges_line$"
+ pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_charged_masterwork: "$pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_masterwork$\n\n$pam_holy_myron_charges_line$"
+ pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_charged_famed: "$pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_famed$\n\n$pam_holy_myron_charges_line$"
+ pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_charged_illustrious: "$pam_holy_myron_artifact_desc_illustrious$\n\n$pam_holy_myron_charges_line$"
+ ### Ingredient glosses
+ pam_myron_gloss_balsam: "Меккский бальзам: ароматная смола, источаемая небольшими кустарниками, что выращивают в Иерихоне и Эйн-Геди близ Мёртвого моря. Самое дорогое благовоние древнего мира. Этот главный ингредиент мира, такие кустарники тщательно охраняются и не растут больше нигде."
+ pam_myron_gloss_frankincense: "Золотистая смола из узловатых деревьев, что растут почти исключительно на юге Аравии. Её жгут перед алтарями с незапамятных времён, она подслащивает миро, а дым этой смолы уносит молитвы в небо."
+ pam_myron_gloss_myrrh: "Горькая, кроваво-красная смола, добываемая из шипастых деревьев юга Аравии и Африканского Рога. В книге Исход она названа среди составляющих священного мира, волхвы подарили её младенцу Иисусу, верующие возложили её на могилу Иисуса."
+ pam_myron_gloss_spikenard: "Тяжёлое, сладковатое масло, выжимаемое из корней растения, что растёт лишь на высоких восточных горах и свозится в порты Индии. Им Иисус был помазан в Вифании — его ученики тогда возмутились трате дорогого масла."
+ pam_myron_gloss_cinnamon: "Сладкая внутренняя кора деревьев, что растут в Индии и на островах за ней. В книге Исход она названа среди составляющих священного мира. Прежде чем добраться до христианских алтарей, она пересекает полмира."
+ pam_myron_gloss_calamus: "Сладкий, ароматный тростник из священного писания, собираемый на восточных болотах. В книге Исход он названа среди составляющих священного мира."
+ pam_myron_gloss_cassia: "Грубая кора сродни корице, соскабливаемая с деревьев дальних стран Востока. В книге Исход она названа среди составляющих священного мира."
```
